newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klestil says no decision on second term.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klestil says no decision on second term.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil said on Saturday he would not make any decision until the autumn on whether to run for a second term in next year's presidential elections.
Klestil, 64, in his first interview since he was struck down with severe pneumonia in September, told state radio he would leave the issue of his candidacy open for the time being.
The elections are due to take place early in 1998.
Klestil became president in 1992 and helped restore Austria's image abroad after his predecessor Kurt Waldheim was shunned by most foreign leaders for concealing his Nazi past.
